topic: The Logic of Abstract Vector Spaces

sections.title: From Concrete to Abstract: The Prerequisite
lecture_lines: Vectors are more than just arrows.
We move beyond simple geometric vectors.
A vector space is a playground.
Two operations define this space: addition and scaling.
These must satisfy eight formal axioms.
animations: An arrow vector (bright blue, #3498db) appears in the center, emerging from a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/playground.svg].
The arrow morphs into a smooth function curve (green, #2ecc71) while maintaining its origin point.
The text 'Vector Space' appears in white (#ffffff) at the top.
An 'Addition' symbol (+) and 'Scalar Multiplier' (c) appear, highlighted in yellow (#f1c40f).
The 8 axioms (represented as 8 floating white dots) orbit the space within the bounds of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/playground.svg].

sections.title: The 8 Axioms: Defining the Rules of the Playground
lecture_lines: The playground requires two specific properties.
First, closure: operations must stay inside.
Second, internal structure: rules like associativity.
Think of it like a vector animal shelter.
If these hold, it is a vector space.
animations: A list of 8 boxes appears, representing the 8 axioms.

The first 4 boxes (Closure group) glow in orange (#e67e22) as a checkmark (#2ecc71, scale 1.0) appears next to them, accompanied by the animal icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg].

The remaining 4 boxes (Structure group) glow in blue (#3498db) as checkmarks (scale 1.0) appear next to each, accompanied by the shelter icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shelter.svg].
The full set of 8 boxes pulse briefly in sequence.
A bold banner 'Vector Space Confirmed!' appears in white (#ffffff) below the grid.

sections.title: Testing the Concept: Polynomials as Vectors
lecture_lines: Add coefficients just like grid coordinates.
animations: Display a polynomial P2: 'x^2 + x' in bold white (#ffffff).
The coefficients [1, 1, 0] appear in an adjacent grid [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] (cyan, #1abc9c) next to the P2 formula.
The grid coordinates and the polynomial are joined by an arrow (#ffffff) to demonstrate isomorphism.

sections.title: Application: Why Abstract Matters
lecture_lines: Think of audio waves as vectors.
animations: An audio waveform (complex curve, purple, #9b59b6) is captured by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg] and fills the screen.
The vector space rules (from Section 1) are superimposed in light gray (#bdc3c7) over the wave.
The waveform is shown being scaled and added, emphasizing the linear algebra foundation as it plays back through a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speaker.svg].
